## Appearing in "Heroes Reunited Part 4: Let It Be"

**Featured Characters:**

*   [⏴](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Iron_Man_Vol_2_12 "Iron Man Vol 2 12")[Captain America](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Steven_Rogers_(Earth-616) "Steven Rogers (Earth-616)")[⏵](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Iron_Man_Vol_2_13 "Iron Man Vol 2 13")

## Synopsis for "Heroes Reunited Part 4: Let It Be"

Story continued from [Iron Man (Vol. 2) #12](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Iron_Man_Vol_2_12 "Iron Man Vol 2 12")...

Back at the mansion, Reed Richards is explaining that their Ultimate Nullifier is complete however it needs someone to wield it and they will surely die. Captain America enters the room with the wounded Bucky and offers himself up, Iron Man and Thor offer themselves in sacrifice as well. Just then, the Silver Surfer, offers himself for the sacrifice. The heroes wire up the Nullifier to the Silver Surfer and armed with Cap's indestructible shield the Silver Surfer goes out to battle Galactus. With an energy boost from the heroes below the Silver Surfer succeeds in absorbing energy and channeling it back into Galactus causing him to overload, destroying them both in the process. The only thing that survives the blast is Cap's shield which he reclaims. With Galactus destroyed, Reed Richards offers his hand to Dr. Doom in friendship but Doom declines.

## Solicit Synopsis



## Notes

*   In this issue, it is revealed that President Truman did not order Steve Rogers to be captured and placed into [Suspended animation](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Glossary:Suspended_animation "Glossary:Suspended animation").

*   This issue of Part IV of "Heroes Reunited". The other chapters took place in the pages the other [Heroes Reborn](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Heroes_Reborn_(1996_Event) "Heroes Reborn (1996 Event)") titles: [Iron Man (Vol. 2) #12](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Iron_Man_Vol_2_12 "Iron Man Vol 2 12"), [Fantastic Four (Vol. 2) #12](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Fantastic_Four_Vol_2_12 "Fantastic Four Vol 2 12"), and [Avengers (Vol. 2) #12](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Avengers_Vol_2_12 "Avengers Vol 2 12").

*   Issue is dedicated to [Mark Gruenwald](https://marvel.fandom.com/wiki/Mark_Gruenwald "Mark Gruenwald"): "To Gru, We Still Miss You."
